findings.title: Untrusted repository content could arrive pre-acknowledged because checkout-local, non-portable operator provenance is not required
The broker allows every documented Orchid verb without argument-level rules or exclusions for privileged trust and service operations
T002 permits direct boundary and status writes even though cross-process boundary artifacts are durable Orchid run state
T002 provides no structured approval truth table or explicit approval-verb requirement, leaving arbitration non-testable
T003 does not explicitly create or safely reuse the required epoch
T004 does not explicitly build a reproducible archive from the exact clean tagged commit
Most task verification commands use ambient bash and therefore do not prove the full suite under Bash 3.2
No task explicitly updates and verifies PROTOCOL.md and CLI help for the deterministic driver and judgment-boundary workflow
